<!--
Thank you for submitting a new AI template!
Please complete each section below. Use the placeholders and guidance to help reviewers understand and validate your submission.
-->

## Template Title

<!--
Short, descriptive name for your template (e.g., "Customer Support Chatbot", "SEO Audit Generator").
-->

## Model & Folder

<!--
Specify which AI model is used and the intended folder/location.
Examples: chatgpt/claude/gemini/copilot/etc.
-->

## Goal

<!--
One sentence outcome. What should this template achieve for the user?
For example: "Generate a summary of recent blog posts and highlight key trends."
-->

## Inputs

<!--
List all variables or prompts users must provide.
For example:
- blog_url
- date_range
- industry
-->

## Acceptance Criteria

<!--
List requirements for the template to be considered complete.
Examples:
- [ ] Template works with the specified model/folder
- [ ] Instructions are clear and actionable
- [ ] Variables are documented and validated
- [ ] Follows org coding standards
- [ ] Example output provided
- [ ] Changelog entry prepared for PR if user-facing
- [ ] PR uses correct branch prefix (ai-template/)
- [ ] Approved by at least one maintainer
-->

## Example

<!--
Provide a minimal example of the template in use, including input and expected output.
For example, show a sample prompt, user variables, and the output generated by the template.
-->

### Definition of Ready (DoR)

<!--
Checklist to ensure the AI template submission is ready for review.
-->

- [ ] Template title and goal clearly defined
- [ ] Model & folder specified
- [ ] Inputs listed and described
- [ ] Example provided
- [ ] Acceptance criteria listed
- [ ] Estimate added (if applicable)

### Definition of Done (DoD)

<!--
Checklist to ensure the AI template is complete and actionable.
-->

- [ ] All acceptance criteria met and verified
- [ ] Changelog entry prepared for PR (CHANGELOG.md)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if needed)
- [ ] Template tested/validated
- [ ] PR uses correct branch prefix (ai-template/)
- [ ] Approved by at least one maintainer
